# Shift handover: multi-topic chat sessions (May 20–30, 2023) · written 2026-11-11 12:00
> Receiver: run /shift-start first, then read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given by the user.
> Source: the conversation itself only. The transcript-mining script could not run (permission prompt not approved), so nothing was recovered from pre-compaction turns.

## 0 · Read these first
No project files. The repo holds only the shift-change skill (commit `1033e60 start`); all the work was chat answers. This handover is the only record.

## 1 · Status
🟡 A string of unrelated advice chats (2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30). Only one thread is clearly open: the **Excel instructor-to-hours model** (latest, 2023-05-30 18:58). Two earlier answers were **cut off mid-reply** (diet plan, Pune→Gujarat road trip) and several answers had factual errors (§9).

## 2 · Picture
Latest thread: the user posed a college capstone scenario ("You are a senior in college, assigned to work with a certain client…"). The client company has exclusive rights to provide technical and managerial training through instructional classes. Planning currently depends on what section managers and instructors happen to know, so the company is losing budget and wasting employee hours. It has **8 Technical Training Sections**, each with its own variables, and faces budget cuts and staff attrition. It wants: (1) an analysis of each section's variables, (2) a relative quantitative measure for each variable, (3) a partial or complete automated MS Excel tool that turns shifting variables into a relative number of instruction hours, which stakeholders can also use to see what happens when staffing or budget goes up or down.
I gave 7 clarifying questions (§6b). The user asked whether I could build the Excel model once they supplied answers. I said **yes** and outlined it (§6b). **The user has not yet supplied the answers.** No file exists yet.

**Mental map**
- [user said] The model must link the number of instructors to the hours of instruction, per section, and respond to budget and attrition changes.
- [assumed, agent] It would be a driver-based model (weighted variables → hours per instructor) with one sheet of inputs per section and a scenario/summary sheet. Not discussed with the user.
- [assumed] "You are a senior" reads as role-play framing, but the user is probably the student doing this capstone. Not confirmed.

## 3 · Next actions
1. Wait for the user's answers to the 7 questions. If they come back partial, ask only for the missing items. · Done when you have, for each of the 8 sections: instructor headcount, hours taught, and the factors that drive the ratio, plus the budget constraints.
2. Build the Excel model as promised (input tables per section → formulas → summary with total instructors, hours and budget estimate, plus a scenario lever for staffing/budget ±). · Done when changing an input visibly changes required instructors and hours.
3. If the user goes back to an older thread, use §6b and §9 (fix known errors; finish the truncated answers).

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Ways to take IRA money out penalty-free to buy a boat or pay for a vacation | Not a qualifying exception. I held this position three times while the user pushed ("I really want to buy that boat", "can't I have a little fun"). Suggested a separate savings goal or a personal loan instead | User is ≥59½, or the purpose actually meets an exception |
| Fish or meat in the diet plan | User: "take out the fish", then "not have any meat or fish but it can include dairy". **My 60+ version wrongly put fish back in, and my last version added a 2-egg omelet.** | Never for fish/meat. Eggs: ask first (North Indian vegetarians often avoid eggs) |
| Very long driving days on the road trip | User and wife "dont prefer very long driving sessions" | — |
| Peppermint tea at bedtime | User raised it as stimulating; I agreed | — |
| More than 5 TikTok keywords per reply | User's own rule: "should not include more than 5 keywords per request" | — |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said], dates are 2023):
- Married; drove Pune→Gujarat with "me and my wife" (05-26). Lives in or near Pune, India [assumed].
- Going for a **promotion** to manager of the information desk at a small private college; they are the **candidate**, not the interviewer (05-21).
- Working on a patent-style system: OCR + ML scanning of documents verified against blockchain verifiable credentials, for a "digital community tax certificate" system. Agencies named: BIR (income tax returns) and an office of permits and licenses (business permits), which points to the Philippines (05-23).
- Has a Roth/traditional IRA question and wants to buy a boat (05-24).
- Attended a spiritual retreat in the mountains on **2023-05-29** ("today"). A Buddhist monk's talk on **impermanence** inspired them. Had a **falling out with their best friend** and is working on forgiveness. Plans to read *The Power of Now* and to **journal daily** about it.
- Board games: played Ticket to Ride and Catan with friends (loved both); has played **Azul with their roommate** and chose Azul for game nights; Wingspan is too long for their usual game nights. Plans an **IKEA KALLAX** plus stackable bins, and will measure before buying (05-29).
- Sleep: late-night **conference calls on Tuesdays and Thursdays**; target bedtime **10:30 pm**. Calming music and journaling already help. Chose **lavender tea**, then **lavender + chamomile**. Caffeine: one coffee in the morning, herbal tea in the afternoon (05-30).
- Has been to **Thomas Land with their niece and nephew**. Now going to Fuji-Q Highland **with friends**, who are all big roller-coaster fans (05-30).
- Wants a North Indian vegetarian, Mediterranean-style diet plan for people **60+ who need to lower cholesterol** (could be for parents; not stated).
- Ran a TikTok ad-keyword exercise for **men's fashion clothing** (05-20).
- Asked for an "Eco project" summary covering the problem, solution, tech, ecosystem/market, ECO token and roadmap. Only my closing confirmation survives in context; the details were lost (05-27).

| I assumed | User corrected | Rule | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interview questions for the panel to ask | User is the interviewee | Check which side of a scenario the user is on | "To clarify, I am the person being interviewed" |
| Fuji-Q companions = niece/nephew | Going with friends this time | Don't carry companions over from earlier trips | "with my friends this time, not my niece and nephew" |
| Suggested alternative terms that were longer / weak | Wanted shorter, better ones | Give shorter, sharper options | "thats actually longer", "come on think in something better" |
| Diet edits only touched the newest constraint | Constraints pile up | Keep every earlier constraint (no fish, south Indian dishes, paneer) when applying a new one | — |
| Long, effusive answers with closing questions | (no explicit complaint) | Prefer direct answers; the user pushes back when unhappy | — |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Instructor model, 7 questions**: (1) current instructors and hours per section; (2) factors driving the ratio (complexity, materials, demand); (3) how those factors are weighed today; (4) budget constraints and expected changes; (5) how attrition affects training and what is being done about it; (6) goal: cut costs, raise efficiency, or improve outcomes; (7) how the model will be used (staffing/budget decisions or internal planning). **Promised model design**: factor tables per section; an input area for required training hours; formulas → instructors needed; a summary of total instructors, hours and budget estimate.
- **TikTok keywords** (10 given): Style, Fashionable, Men'swear, Trendy, Streetwear; Clothing, Apparel, Outfit, Closet, Dress up. Don't repeat these.
- **Promotion closing questions**: 10 given, including "any reservations about my qualifications", KPIs for the role, support and resources, and decision timeline.
- **Document-verification pseudocode**: online submission → check the blockchain → if absent, send for agency approval (BIR / permits office) → once approved, auto-store on the blockchain via OCR → NLP → ML comparison → verifiable-credential signature → notify the user.
- **IRA figures I quoted**: $6,000 limit / $7,000 if 50+ ("2021"); RMDs at 72; $10k first-time home; medical >10% AGI. Several are stale or wrong (§9).
- **Road trip** (cut off): Thu Pune→Nashik (~210 km) · Fri Nashik→Vadodara (~360 km) · Sat Vadodara→Ahmedabad, then evening drive toward **Udaipur**, Sun cut off. Flaws: Udaipur is in Rajasthan, not Gujarat; no return leg to Pune by Sunday night.
- **Diet** (last version cut off at dinner): quinoa porridge, omelet (eggs: error), fruit + low-fat yogurt; apple + nuts, roasted chana; grilled paneer salad, brown rice + sambar; carrot/cucumber + hummus, masala chai; dinner unfinished. Dosa/uthappam dropped out after the 60+ revision; they should go back in.
- **Board games**: recommended Sagrada, Qwirkle, Bärenpark; Sterilite / IRIS / Rubbermaid bins.
- **Sleep**: bedtime routine with a 9:30 pm reminder; 4-7-8 and box breathing; lavender-chamomile at **1:1**, steeped 5–7 min.
- **Books**: list includes *The Power of Now*, *Untethered Soul*, *Miracle of Mindfulness*, *Wherever You Go…*, and others. I recommended *The Power of Now* as a starting point and for impermanence and forgiveness.
- **Wolves**: hunting methods, pack roles, feeding order (hierarchy plus kill/pack size), conflict resolution (dominance and submission).

## 9 · Gotchas: errors I made that may come back
- **Thomas Land is inside Fuji-Q Highland.** I wrongly said they were separate parks. Correct this if it comes up.
- Fuji-Q: "Odin" and "Highway Hero" are not real Fuji-Q coasters; the "Fujiyama Station / Panorama Zone" viewpoints and the "Fujiyama curry" were invented; Dodonpa's launch speed was stated wrong (it is much faster, ~180 km/h); Takabisha's maximum drop is 121°, but I also called it a "90-degree drop". Verify before repeating any of these.
- IRA: since the SECURE Act there is no age limit on traditional IRA contributions; the RMD age is now 73; the medical threshold is 7.5% of AGI; limits have risen since 2021. Re-check current IRS figures.
- Azul *Summer Pavilion* and *Stained Glass of Sintra* are standalone games, not expansions. I said "Wingspan is similar to Ticket to Ride" and "Azul is similar to Catan", which are weak comparisons.
- The 2023-05-27 "thats actually longer" thread asked for a shorter term for compulsive sexual behaviours. The original term the user wanted shortened is not in context. Options given: sexual compulsions, sexual fixations, problematic sexual behaviors, sexual impulsivity, compulsive sexuality. The user wasn't satisfied.

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means |
|---|---|
| "Sections" | the client's 8 Technical Training Sections (one per training discipline) |
| BIR | Bureau of Internal Revenue (Philippines) |

---

question: In our previous chat, you suggested 'sexual compulsions' and a few other options for alternative terms for certain behaviors. Can you remind me what the other four options were?
gold: I suggested 'sexual fixations', 'problematic sexual behaviors', 'sexual impulsivity', and 'compulsive sexuality'.
answer:
Besides "sexual compulsions," the other four options I suggested were:

1. **Sexual fixations**
2. **Problematic sexual behaviors**
3. **Sexual impulsivity**
4. **Compulsive sexuality**

You weren't happy with these, and some were longer than what you asked for. I no longer have the original term you wanted shortened. If you send it again, I'll come up with shorter, sharper options.
